name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_ex17c_item_load_from_zrd
description: HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Item::LoadFromZrd loads the base ZRD widget, snapshots selected/unselected image pointers, computes the item mouse rectangle from recovered bounds, and applies an optional MOUSERECT override.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C item/table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b8850 validates the base LoadFromZrd call, image pointer snapshots at offsets 0x16c through 0x178, bounds computation from ftable GetCenterX/GetCenterY, image/label fallback paths, mouseRect copy at offset 0x15c, and optional zReader::GetNamedNode lookup for MOUSERECT.
The native smoke verifies loaded image snapshot state, mouseRectValid, image-backed bounds, MOUSERECT offset application, and the modeled item ftable slot 31 pointing to LoadFromZrd.
